title: Ukulele Path
subtitle: High-G tenor ukulele from first chords to fingerstyle solos and chord melody.
benchmark: RSL Ukulele Grade 5, LCM Ukulele Grade 5

levels.title: First chords, first strums, first melodies
levels.goal: Strum four chords in time and pick a melody on the open strings.
levels.adds: C, Am, F, G7, G; down strums and down-up; thumb strokes; first-position reading.

steps.title: Tune the ukulele
steps.setup: The tuner, all four strings, high-G (re-entrant). The app does not yet ask high-G or low-G and keep it in settings.
steps.done: All four strings within 10 cents in under a minute.

steps.title: Build C, Am and F
steps.setup: Chords, Build: C, then Am and F.
steps.done: Each shape clean 5 times running (every string sounds), on two days.
steps.feeds: Let It Be, Stand By Me

steps.title: Build G7, then G
steps.setup: Chords, Build: G7, then G.
steps.done: Each shape clean 5 times running, on two days.

steps.title: Down strums on four chords
steps.setup: Phrases: Four chords, 60 then 80.
steps.done: 3 runs at 90% at 80, on two days.
steps.feeds: Let It Be, Stand By Me

steps.title: One-minute changes
steps.setup: Chords, Changes: timed, 60 seconds, one pair at a time: C-Am, Am-F, F-C, C-G7, F-G7.
steps.done: 30 changes a minute on each pair (JustinGuitar's bar), on two days.

steps.title: Down, down-up
steps.setup: Rhythm, read and tap: D DU D DU.
steps.done: 5 runs at 80% at 80.

steps.title: Thumb, then a pinch
steps.setup: Chords, Fingerpicking: thumb, then two strings together, over C F G7, 60.
steps.done: 3 runs at 80% at 70, on two days.

steps.title: Open-string melodies
steps.setup: Phrases: Twinkle, Mary Had a Little Lamb, Ode to Joy.
steps.done: Each phrase 3 runs at 90% at the phrase tempo, on two days.

steps.title: Read the first notes
steps.setup: Note reading, Flashcards: the Primer range, C4 to C5 (frets 0 to 3).
steps.done: 20 notes at 90%, under 3 seconds each.

steps.title: Major or minor
steps.setup: Ear, Chord qualities: major and minor.
steps.done: 20 answers at 80%.

steps.title: First whole song
steps.setup: Strum a progression with a shelf song's chords and strum pattern.
steps.done: One shelf song start to end, 3 runs at 80% (chords and timing), no stops.

levels.title: Island strum, chucks and the claw
levels.goal: The strums most pop ukulele songs use, and the first real fingerpicking patterns.
levels.adds: Island strum, chuck, reggae offbeat; Dm, C7, A7, D7, E7, Em, D; the claw and alternating thumb; the C major scale.

levels.goal: The strokes and textures that make a solo ukulele sound full.
levels.adds: Formby split stroke, triple stroke, fan strokes (rasgueado); tremolo; p-a-m-i arpeggio studies; slurs and slides; natural harmonics; classical reading in sharp and flat keys; campanella in a minor key.

steps.title: Formby split stroke
steps.setup: Rhythm, read and tap: the split stroke, D dU D dU with the accent on the up after 2 and 4.
steps.done: 5 runs at 80% at 120.

steps.title: Triple stroke
steps.setup: Rhythm, read and tap: a triple-stroke study in the RSL Grade 5 manner, triplets on 1 and 3, D U on 2 and 4.
steps.done: 4 bars at 90, 80%.

steps.title: Fan strokes (rasgueado)
steps.setup: Rhythm, read and tap: a four-finger roll on 1 and 3.
steps.done: 5 runs at 80% at 80.

steps.title: Tremolo
steps.setup: One string, i m or p a m i, graded on note evenness.
steps.done: Even within your baseline at 4 notes a beat, 70.
steps.needs: A tremolo drill graded on note evenness (rec 11).

steps.title: p-a-m-i arpeggio triplets
steps.setup: Chords, Fingerpicking: thumb, then a m i, at 3 notes a click; then Spanish Romance in Song Studio.
steps.done: The pattern 3 runs at 85% at 90, on two days; the piece at 80%.

steps.title: Slurs and slides
steps.setup: Fretboard, Hammer-ons and pull-offs.
steps.done: 3 runs at 85%, on two days.

steps.title: Natural harmonics at frets 12, 7 and 5
steps.setup: A harmonics check: the pitch an octave or more above the open string.
steps.done: 12 harmonics at 90% pitch.

steps.title: Classical piece one
steps.setup: Song Studio: Lágrima or Spanish Romance, with fix-the-spot loops.
steps.done: Performance 85% at tempo, on two days.

steps.title: Classical piece two
steps.setup: Song Studio: Gymnopédie, or Für Elise (low-G).
steps.done: Performance 85% at tempo, on two days.

steps.title: Classical reading
steps.setup: Sight-reading, level 3, in D major and Bb major (the app's levels stop at 3).
steps.done: 80% in each key, 3 runs on two days; level 6 once the app has it.

steps.title: Campanella in minor
steps.setup: Phrases: D harmonic minor in campanella (RSL Grade 6 to 8, high-G).
steps.done: 3 runs at 95% at 90.

steps.title: Cadences by ear
steps.setup: Ear, Cadences: authentic (V-I) and plagal (IV-I).
steps.done: 20 answers at 80%.

levels.title: Up the neck and improvising
levels.goal: Solo freely over blues, minor tunes and simple standards, and find any chord up the neck.
levels.adds: Minor pentatonic in five positions, the blues scale and major pentatonic mixed over dominant chords; slides, small bends, double stops; chord-tone soloing; minor ii-V; call and response; transcribing four bars.

steps.title: Minor pentatonic, five positions
steps.setup: Ukulele positions 1 to 5 in A and C.
steps.done: Each position 3 runs at 95% at 90.
steps.needs: Ukulele scale positions: minor pentatonic in five positions (rec 4).

steps.title: One chord in five places up the neck
steps.setup: Chords, Build: C in its five forms from open to fret 12 (the ukulele's version of guitar CAGED: the guitar's top four strings capoed at 5, so its C A G E D forms become F D C A G here). Then Am the same way.
steps.done: Each form rings clean 3 times running, on two days.
steps.feeds: comping and soloing up the neck

steps.title: Move through the forms in time
steps.setup: Chords, Changes: C through its five forms up the neck and back, timed. The microphone hears C in every form, so play the forms you built; MIDI or the on-screen frets tell them apart.
steps.done: 20 changes a minute through the cycle, clean, on two days.

steps.title: Blues scale and major pentatonic
steps.setup: Scales: A blues, then A major pentatonic. A second position waits for ukulele scale positions.
steps.done: Each 3 runs at 95% at 90, on two days.

steps.title: Slides, bends, double stops
steps.setup: Fretboard, Bends and vibrato: half-step bends. Hammer-ons and pull-offs alongside.
steps.done: Bends within 30 cents of a semitone, 8 of 10, on two days.

steps.title: Call and response
steps.setup: Ear, Melody dictation: play back, minor degrees (no blues level yet). The ukulele blues phrases from 5.6, in other keys, are coming.
steps.done: 10 phrases at 80%.

steps.title: Chord tones over I7 IV7 V7
steps.setup: Jazz licks on ukulele; then Jam's blues in Check, chord tones on beats 1 and 3.
steps.done: 3 choruses where the chorus report shows chord tones on beats 1 and 3 at 60%.

steps.title: Minor ii-V and Dorian
steps.setup: Jam in Check: minor ii-V-i, then modal, on ukulele.
steps.done: 4 choruses at 80% scale tones.

steps.title: Solo over a song's chords
steps.setup: Jam on a progression taken from a song's chord chart.
steps.done: 2 choruses on Summertime at 80%.
steps.needs: A Jam progression from a song's chord chart, with a pass rule on the chorus report (rec 9).

steps.title: Comp and trade
steps.setup: Jam: comp one chorus, solo one chorus, recorded in Practice Lab.
steps.done: 4 alternating choruses without a stop.

steps.title: Transcribe four bars
steps.setup: Song Studio transcription of one melody line from a recorded solo, corrected in the note editor.
steps.done: 4 bars played back at 80% in performance mode.
steps.needs: Song Studio runs on your own transcription counted for a path step (rec 1).

steps.title: Hear the changes in a blues
steps.setup: Ear, Progressions: I7, IV7 and V7, with the quick change.
steps.done: 20 answers at 80%.

levels.title: A concert programme
levels.adds: Programme planning, fix-the-spot work at full length, dynamics, memory, a first arrangement of your own and a recorded performance.

steps.title: Choose a programme
steps.setup: Three shelf pieces (pop, classical, jazz or Hawaiian), 10 to 12 minutes, from your songs.
steps.done: The list saved in the journal.

steps.title: Fix the hard spots
steps.setup: Song Studio fix-the-spot loops on each piece's three hardest bars.
steps.done: 3 clean loops at tempo per spot.
steps.needs: Song Studio fix-the-spot loops counted per spot for a path step (rec 1).

steps.title: Whole pieces at tempo
steps.setup: Song Studio, performance mode, each programme piece.
steps.done: Each piece at 90% on two days.

steps.title: Dynamics
steps.setup: A loudness contour on a take: louder or softer where the score says (experimental).
steps.done: Two marked contrasts heard in the take.
steps.needs: A loudness contour on a take (rec 15).

steps.title: Memory
steps.setup: Practice Lab: each piece from memory.
steps.done: 2 takes per piece without a stop.

steps.title: Arrange your own
steps.setup: A chord melody of a song you choose, 16 bars, written in Create or MuseScore and imported.
steps.done: Plays at 80% in Song Studio.

steps.title: Improvise an intro and a tag
steps.setup: Jam on the piece's chords: a 4-bar intro and a 4-bar ending.
steps.done: Recorded with the piece.

steps.title: Unprepared reading
steps.setup: Sight-reading, level 3, a new piece (the app's levels stop at 3).
steps.done: One pass at 80%; level 6 once the app has it.

steps.title: Accompany at sight
steps.setup: Strum a progression with an unseen chart from Jam (LCM unprepared accompaniment).
steps.done: 16 bars at 80% on the first try.
steps.needs: Runs that count in Strum a progression (rec 2). It has song presets and strum patterns now; its runs stay practice only until chord following is checked on a real instrument.

steps.title: Perform
steps.setup: Practice Lab: the whole programme in one take.
steps.done: One take, listened back, three notes written in the journal.
